viewAgreement.select: select a.agrmnt_id AS "AgrmntId", a.agrmnt_no AS "AgrmntNo", d.full_name AS "DebtorName", a.inst_amt AS "MonthlyInstallmentAmount", coalesce((select min(s.inst_seq_no) from inst_schdl s where s.agrmnt_id = a.agrmnt_id and s.inst_paid_amt < s.inst_amt), 0) AS "NextInstallmentSequence"
viewAgreement.from: from agrmnt a left join debtor d on a.debtor_id = d.debtor_id
